def f(g):

    # find 2x2 square
    sq=[(i,j) for i in range(H-1) for j in range(W-1) if g[i][j]==g[i][j+1]==g[i+1][j]==g[i+1][j+1]==2]
    s=sq[0]; sqc=(s[0]+s[1]+s[0]+s[1])/2  # center row,col approx (s[0]+0.5,s[1]+0.5)
    cr,cn=s[0]+0.5,s[1]+0.5
    dirs={(0,-1),(0,1),(-1,0),(1,0)}|{} 
    mcells=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=0 and g[i][j]!=2]
    for i,j,c in mcells:
        # two diagonal directions; pick one whose ray reaches the square's line
        res=None
        for di,dj in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
            x,y=i+di,j+dj; ok=False
            while 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]!=2:
                x+=di; y+=dj
            if (x+s[1]-j)*(y+s[0]-i)<=0 and x*s[1]>=0:
                 # ray continues past (or touches) the square's column band roughly
                 ok=True
            if ok:
                res=di,dj; break
        if res:
            di,dj=res; x,y=i+di,j+dj
            while 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]!=2:
                g[x][y]=c; x+=di; y+=dj
    return g

import os,glob,re,json
def load():

from collections import defaultdict
def maxruns(cells):
    cells=set(cells); res=[]
    for s in sorted(cells):
        if s in done: continue
        for di,dj in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
            y,x=s; seg=[s]; 
            while (y+di,x+dj) in cells: seg.append((y+di,x+dj)); y,x=y+di,x+dj
            # backward
            y,x=s
            while (y-di,x-dj) in cells: seg.insert(0,(y-di,x-dj)); y,x=y-di,x-dj
            done.update(seg); res.append(seg)
    return res

from collections import defaultdict
def analyze(p):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    print('=== pair',p,'H,W',H,W)
    # distribution counts
    ci=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); co=Counter(x for r in O for x in r)
    print('in counts:',dict(ci))
    print('out counts:',dict(co))
    twos={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==2}
    # for each output non-2 cell, distance to nearest 2-cell (Manhattan & diagonal-step count)
    def dstep(i,j):
        best=99
        for t in twos:
            di=abs(i-t[0]); dj=abs(j-t[1])
            # min steps of diagonal moves (+ straight)
            m=max(di,dj)-min(di,dj)
            best=min(best,m+min(di,dj)-m)
        return best
    stats=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if O[i][j]!=2:
                stats[O[i][j]].append((i,j,dstep(i,j)))
    for c in sorted(stats):
        print('color',c,[sorted(v)[:6] for v in [stats[c]]],'count',len(stats[c]))
analyze(4)

def segs(I,O):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    twos={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==2}
    out=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if O[i][j]!=2)
    res=[]
    used=set()
    for s in sorted(out):
        if s in used: continue
        # longest contiguous run through s on either diag
        best=[]
        for d1,d2 in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
            y,x=s; seg=[s]; k=0
            while (y+d1,x+d2) in out: seg.append((y+d1,x+d2)); y+=d1; x+=d2; k+=1
            y,x=s; k1=0
            while (y-d1,x-d2) in out: seg.insert(0,(y-d1,x-d2)); y-=d1; x-=d2; k1+=1
            if len(seg)>len(best): best=seg
        used|=set(best); res.append((tuple(best),best and best[0]))
    return res

    used=set()

        line=[]
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):

            while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and (rr,cc)!=(r,c):

                line.append((rr,cc))
                rr+=dr; cc+=dc
            else: continue
            break
        # backtrack full diagonal both ways
        if (r,c) in used: continue
        seg=[]
        rr,cc=r-1,c-1
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and O[rr][cc]==o:

        seg+=[(r,c)]
        rr,cc=r+1,c+1
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and O[rr][cc]==o:
            seg.append((rr,cc)); rr+=1; cc+=1
        # also perpendicular through it

        rr,cc=r-1,c+1
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and O[rr][cc]==o:
            seg2.append((rr,cc)); rr-=1; cc+=1
        seg2+=(r,c); 
        rr,cc=r+1,c-1
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and O[rr][cc]==o:
            seg2.append((rr,cc)); rr+=1; cc-=1
        s=seg2 if len(seg2)>len(seg) else seg
        if s!=[(r,c)]:
            ends=s[-1]; srev=s[::-1]; other=s[-2] if len(s)>1 else None
            print(' color',o,'diag len',len(s),'ends',s[0],s[-1],'mid',s[len(s)//2],'corners near:',end=' ')
            for (r0,c0) in blks:

                hit=[p for p in pts if (p in s or abs(p[0]-ends[0])+abs(p[1]-ends[1])==2)]
                print(hit)
        used.add((r,c))
